tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. White like a Wikipedia article page; structure comes from grey boxes and hairlines, not from a tinted ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the diff viewer, inputs: white on white, defined only by their 1px border (Wikipedia's flat, boxed look).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Infobox grey: side panels (Why flagged, Assessment, rail), toolbars, table headers, skeletons, default buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders around cards and between rows (Wikipedia's subtle border).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, buttons, toggles) and the rule under serif headings. 4.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, claim headlines (Wikipedia's base text colour).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, timestamps, labels, Finnish originals under English. 7:1 on white, 6.6:1 on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, the primary (progressive) button, focus, selection: Wikipedia's link blue, so links look like links. Never used to mean a tier. 5.3:1 on white.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (primary button).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected chip / active filter / pressed toggle background, highlighted card ring, brushed chart range.

tokens.name: tier-reverted-bg
tokens.usage: Tier 1 badge fill: “Removed by Wikipedia editors”. Plain infobox grey: most removals are vandalism.

tokens.name: tier-reverted-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tier-reverted-bg (7:1).

tokens.name: tier-reverted-line
tokens.usage: Tier 1 badge border.

tokens.name: tier-reverted-mark
tokens.usage: Tier 1 marker on charts: drawn HOLLOW (1.5px stroke), so it differs from tiers 2–3 by fill as well as tone.

tokens.name: tier-contested-bg
tokens.usage: Tier 2 badge fill: “Disputed and removed”. A barely-warm tint, close to Wikipedia's notice boxes, not a highlighter.

tokens.name: tier-contested-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tier-contested-bg (8:1).

tokens.name: tier-contested-line
tokens.usage: Tier 2 badge border.

tokens.name: tier-contested-mark
tokens.usage: Tier 2 marker on charts: a filled diamond. 4.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: tier-campaign-bg
tokens.usage: Tier 3 badge fill: “Pattern consistent with a coordinated attempt”. A muted plum-grey tint: the top level is told apart by its 3 pips and wording, not by alarm colour.

tokens.name: tier-campaign-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tier-campaign-bg (11:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: tier-campaign-line
tokens.usage: Tier 3 badge border.

tokens.name: tier-campaign-mark
tokens.usage: Tier 3 marker on charts: a filled square, the darkest mark. Muted plum, 7.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: diff-add-bg
tokens.usage: Inserted text in the diff viewer: a soft blue tint (Wikipedia's diff uses blue for added). Removed text is orange and also struck through, so colour is never the only cue.

tokens.name: diff-add-ink
tokens.usage: Text on diff-add-bg (8:1).

tokens.name: diff-del-bg
tokens.usage: Removed text in the diff viewer: a soft orange tint, always with line-through.

tokens.name: diff-del-ink
tokens.usage: Text on diff-del-bg (8:1).

tokens.name: evidence-bg
tokens.usage: Evidence span: the exact words a signal or the assessment points at. A faint tint; the dashed underline does most of the work.

tokens.name: chart-named
tokens.usage: Article timeline: edits by registered accounts (lower, darker stack).

tokens.name: chart-anon
tokens.usage: Article timeline: edits by anonymous / IP accounts (upper, lighter stack). Differs from chart-named in lightness.

tokens.name: chart-band
tokens.usage: Shaded conflict episode (edit war) behind the bars.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines and the baseline on charts; quieter than line.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Completed pipeline stage tick, ‘corpus connected’. Never on incident content.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Degraded-service banner (LLM unavailable, results from cache).

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on warn-bg (8:1).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: System errors only (corpus down, run failed): icon and heading of the error panel. Never used for tiers or incident content, so ‘red’ never means ‘guilty’.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Error panel background.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Lato, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: t-claim
styles.sample: Finland started the Winter War by shelling Mainila.
styles.usage: The claim headline on incident cards and the incident page: the serif marks it as quoted content under examination, not our own statement.

styles.name: t-claim-lg
styles.sample: Finland started the Winter War by shelling Mainila.
styles.usage: The claim on the incident detail page header.

styles.name: t-h1
styles.usage: Page title (topic, article): serif, normal weight, with a 1px line-strong rule under it, the way Wikipedia titles an article.

styles.name: t-h2
styles.usage: Section headings on detail pages: serif with a rule under it, like an article's == Section ==.

styles.name: t-h3
styles.usage: Panel and card-group headings: sans bold, no rule (Wikipedia's === subsection ===).

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Inserted 4 times by 3 accounts over 2 years; live for 61 days in total.

styles.name: t-small
styles.sample: First seen 3 Mar 2014 · last removed 9 Jan 2016
styles.usage: Metadata, chips, table cells, Finnish originals under English.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and tier badge text (badge uses sentence case).

styles.name: t-wikitext
styles.usage: Raw wikitext view in the diff viewer.

styles.name: t-data
styles.usage: Counts, revision ids, durations in the stage tracker and fact rows (tabular numerals).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, pip gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, badge padding, inline groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between page columns.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing on detail pages; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Landing hero top/bottom space.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Everything: badges, chips, buttons, inputs, cards, panels. Wikipedia/Codex corners are near-square; 2px only softens the pixel.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Alias of radius-sm kept for the cards and buttons that name it; do not round further.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The landing search box. Same 2px: big boxes stay square too.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Focus: a crisp inner 1px accent line on top of a 1px accent border (Codex's focus style), no glow.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: tooltips, the reconnect dialog, chart hover cards.
